the validator's bridge candidates.

A7 is built as PoC 1 (bench_spec.py, out/poc1_parts_list.md), which supersedes its column here: no
programmable attenuators (rows 4 and 8 are 0 for PoC 1, row 5 is one SMA cable per hop, no J7204B, and rows
10-11 count PoC 1's fixed pads and one IF cable per tile path: the 'PoC 1:' figures in the A7 column); every IF
tile path has a fixed BW-S pad stack, and each IP-50 hop is a fixed 70 dB chain (2 x SA18S10W-30 + BW-S10W2+,
one SMA cable).

## V-band RF mesh per option

- **A** (final plan only): 9 paths (CORE–N, E1–HUB, E1–N, E2–HUB, E2–W2, HUB–S, HUB–W1, HUB–W2, S–W1); 12 sector ports, 6 with a splitter.
- **A7** (final plan only): 9 paths (E1–HUB, E1–N, E2–HUB, E2–W2, HUB–N, HUB–S, HUB–W1, HUB–W2, S–W1); 12 sector ports, 6 with a splitter.
- **B**: 14 paths (E1–HUB, E1–S, E1–W1, E1–W2, E2–HUB, E2–S, E2–W1, E2–W2, HUB–S, HUB–W1, HUB–W2, S–W1, S–W2, W1–W2); 13 sector ports, 8 with a splitter.
- **C**: 15 paths (E1–E2, E1–HUB, E1–S, E1–W1, E1–W2, E2–HUB, E2–S, E2–W1, E2–W2, HUB–S, HUB–W1, HUB–W2, S–W1, S–W2, W1–W2); 14 sector ports, 9 with a splitter.
- **D**: 6 paths (E1–E2, E1–HUB, E1–W1, E2–HUB, E2–W1, HUB–W1); 7 sector ports, 4 with a splitter.

A and A7 (the selected option and its version on the delivered N367 kit) cable only their
final plan: the pre-event TG links plus the chosen bridges. B, C and D are sized for every
feasible bridge candidate.

How the bench emulates the radio layer: each programmable attenuator holds its path at the
loss the geometry gives (the figures' link budget); at t0 the PDUs switch CORE and HUB off, which
takes every path to them down (attenuators drop only links between survivors); a MARL bridge is a cabled candidate path that
the engaged site brings up; on the PoC 1 bench fixed pads hold each path at the model loss, the PDUs
switch the dead devices off at t0, and a bridge is held down with Terragraph ignition until MARL engages it.
Confirm with Siklu that the TG units are available with RF test
ports, and the port type (waveguide or connector) the V-band parts must match.
